title: “WE REVIEWED THE EVIDENCE.” OK… THEN TEST IT?!
description: YouTube-style thumbnail on Q2: two cards — WHAT REPORTERS HAD (screenshots + emails, not the direct messages) vs WHAT NO ONE HAS ASKED FOR (warrants, forensics, chain of custody) — with Platner’s photo captioned DIGITAL EVIDENCE IS TESTABLE.
alt_text: YouTube-style thumbnail. Big text: “WE REVIEWED THE EVIDENCE.” then in yellow: OK… THEN TEST IT?! Two cards: green-bordered WHAT REPORTERS HAD — screenshots and emails, by their own account not the direct messages themselves; amber-bordered WHAT NO ONE HAS ASKED FOR — warrants, forensics, chain of custody, the one process built to verify it. A circular photo of Graham Platner is captioned DIGITAL EVIDENCE IS TESTABLE.
